title: invoke
description: Execute a method on the host and return a typed promise of the result.
signature: invoke<T = unknown>(method: string, params?: unknown, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<T>
errors: KaavaRpcError with code Timeout if the request does not complete within timeoutMs
KaavaRpcError with code MethodNotFound if the method does not exist on the host
KaavaRpcError with code InvalidParams if params fail validation
semantics: Routes to the host (orchestrator shell via window messages or standalone Tauri app) and returns the result or throws a KaavaRpcError.
